source.projection: Fresh Elementor page structure and Elementor document settings plus public post-68.css

operations.previous_style: min-width: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0px;

operations.desired: ۱ از ۳ · مدت اشتراک را انتخاب کن

preserve: Existing horizontal sizing and gutters, document template and sibling order, hero art/copy/CTA/gradient and visibility on step 1, heading h2 and element IDs, duration choices and existing purchase navigation.
acceptance: Hero height is at least the current visible viewport height, with enough room for content on short or zoomed viewports.
The hero-to-duration-section gap is 32 px at widths below 768 px and 48 px otherwise.
The heading announces ۱ از ۳ next to its existing title. The guest CTA and navigation to and from plan selection still work.
No horizontal overflow at representative viewport widths.
proof_before_write: Draft proposal over the public page measured successful hero sizing, unchanged inline width, correct section gaps and no horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 509, 767, 768, 1024, 1160, 1440 and 1920 CSS px.
rollback: Recheck current supported source. Reverse only the two exact CSS edits and the two targeted element fields if they still match this change. Retain the fresh view and native undo IDs; use document-level revision restoration only if no intervening work would be lost.
